name: shopping-research
description: Product search, cross-retailer prices, Amazon price history, and community deals over free sources, with self-reported coverage on every call.

serpapi_key.title: SerpApi API key
serpapi_key.description: Free key from serpapi.com (250 searches a month). Powers Google Shopping search and per-merchant offers. Leave blank to run without it.

serpapi_monthly_budget.title: SerpApi monthly budget
serpapi_monthly_budget.description: Hard stop on SerpApi searches per calendar month. The server refuses calls past it.

ebay_client_id.title: eBay client ID
ebay_client_id.description: Application keyset from developer.ebay.com. Leave blank to skip eBay.

ebay_client_secret.title: eBay client secret
ebay_client_secret.description: Paired with the client ID; the server fetches and caches its own OAuth token.

bestbuy_api_key.title: Best Buy API key
bestbuy_api_key.description: Free key from developer.bestbuy.com. Leave blank to skip Best Buy.

target_enabled.title: Query Target
target_enabled.description: Target's search endpoint is undocumented and may block automated requests; turn off if it keeps reporting blocked.
